Dining — Café

François

A warm and welcoming café serving expertly brewed coffee, fresh-baked pastries, and wholesome meals. Perfect for breakfast, brunch, or a relaxed afternoon break.

About François

François is the heart of Mambourin Marketplace's café scene — a place where the aroma of freshly brewed single-origin coffee greets you at the door and the display cabinet is always full of tempting pastries baked that morning.

Our menu celebrates the simple pleasure of quality ingredients prepared with care. Start your day with a perfectly extracted flat white and a butter croissant, or settle in for a more substantial brunch — eggs your way, smashed avo, or our rotating seasonal special.

We're a favourite meeting spot for locals, whether it's a quick mid-morning coffee after the grocery run or a catch-up with friends over lunch. Every Tuesday, enjoy 10% off your entire order. See our current offers for details.

Opening Hours

Mon – Fri7:00am – 4:00pm
Sat – Sun7:30am – 3:00pm

Find Us in Centre

Located at the entrance to the Dining Precinct on the east side of Mambourin Marketplace. Look for the chalk board menu outside.
